item.title: Haiti qualifies for U-17 men’s FIFA World Cup for second straight time
item.description: Here we go again. Haiti’s U-17 men are heading back to the World Cup after a decisive 2-1 win over Guatemala. This is the second straight qualification for Les Petits Grenadiers, making it the country’s fourth appearance in that category.
